copy.tagline: 为 API 端点添加高级过滤与排序能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建需要灵活过滤和排序的 API 端点。
copy.tagline_en: Add advanced filtering and sorting to your API endpoints
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building API endpoints that need flexible filtering and sorting.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你生成 API 的过滤和排序代码——解析查询参数、验证允许的字段、构建数据库查询，并优化性能。
howto.when: 当你需要给 API 添加搜索、过滤或排序功能，比如构建商品列表的筛选接口时，Claude 就会接入。

say.text: 帮我写一个按价格范围过滤商品的API
实现按评分降序排序的功能
say.note: Claude 会添加 sort 参数并处理排序逻辑

say.text: 为搜索接口添加分类和库存状态过滤
say.note: Claude 会扩展查询参数并验证字段

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude helps you generate API filtering and sorting code: parse query parameters, validate allowed fields, build database queries, and optimize performance.
howto.when_en: When you need to add search, filter, or sort functionality to an API, such as building a product listing filter interface, Claude will step in.

say_en.text: Write an API to filter products by price range
say_en.note: Claude generates code parsing minPrice and maxPrice parameters

say_en.text: Implement sorting by rating in descending order
say_en.note: Claude adds sort parameter and handles sorting logic

say_en.text: Add category and stock status filters to the search endpoint
say_en.note: Claude extends query parameters and validates fields
